d: Join Coach Dan as he takes on the incredible challenge of running the QC Megatrail 110k race, one of the most grueling and awe-inspiring ultramarathons in the world. Coach Dan gives us an up-close look at the physical and mental demands of running 110 kilometers through the unforgiving terrain of the QC trails. From the stunning mountain views to the brutal weather conditions and everything in between, experience every high and low as Coach Dan battles exhaustion, narrowly avoids injury, and takes on the sheer magnitude of this world-class race!
